item.title: She Forgave Him, So He Decapitated Her
item.description: Ashley Young, 31, disappeared in November 2018 after being seen with Jared Chance in Grand Rapids, Michigan. The following month, a neighbor discovered blood in the basement of Chance’s rental home. Police found Ashley’s torso inside a box, but her head and other remains were never recovered. Investigators also uncovered evidence that Chance’s parents had helped him move items connected to the case. Before Ashley’s disappearance, Chance had reportedly bragged about knowing how to get away with murder. In 2019, he was convicted of second-degree murder and sentenced to 100 to 200 years in prison He bragged that he knew how to get away with murder. What made him think he could hide the evidence forever?

item.title: Their Daughter Broke Seven Years of Silence About Her Sister.
item.description: Shafilea Ahmed was 17 when she disappeared from Warrington after resisting a forced marriage and her parents’ control. For seven years, her younger sister kept silent about what she had witnessed at home. Her account raises a painful question: how do you ask for protection when the people you fear are your own parents, and speaking up could put your brothers and sisters at risk too?
